faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMSRDE Paid Internship?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of applications for the DMSRDE Paid Internship is 28th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this internship?
faq.answer: Candidates must be in their final year of B.Tech/M.Tech/M.Sc in specific disciplines like Chemical Engineering, Polymer Science, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Textile Engineering, Chemistry, or Textile from a recognized Indian University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the DMSRDE Paid Internship?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this internship is 28 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend offered for this internship?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of Rs. 5000 per month for the duration of the internship.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the internship?
faq.answer: The selection process includes CGPA-based shortlisting, followed by an online interview/interaction, document verification, and finally, the preparation of a merit list.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Paid Internship recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the DMSRDE Paid Internship?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it, and send it via post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is DMSRDE located?
faq.answer: DMSRDE is located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 208013.

faq.question: Q9. When will the selected students be intimated?
faq.answer: Selected students will be intimated on 13th October 2026. This will be followed by the commencement of the internship on 26th October 2026.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents, which typically include a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant academic certificates as per the official notification.
